payload.title: Outlier Detection with Pyleoclim
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates outlier detection using clustering algorithms in the Pyleoclim library. It focuses on two main algorithms: k-means and DBSCAN, applied to paleoclimate data in LiPD format. The notebook explains the parameters and diagnostic metrics of each algorithm, and how to apply them for effective outlier detection. It also covers the use of Local Outlier Factor (LOF) for identifying outliers based on distance from cluster centroids.
goals: Apply detection algorithm and understand the difference between k-means and DBSCAN in Pyleoclim
Understand the diagnostic metrics returned by each algorithm
Understand the parameters and when to apply them
